name: The Machynes of Wrestling

tenures.role: tag team: PWA Tag Team Champions from 2 July 2011
tenures.note: Shaw Xtreme names himself and Icon The Machynes of Wrestling in a promo of 20 June and challenges Victor and CM Monster; the pair win the Tag Team Championships in the 2 July ladder match against them.

caption: Icon and Shaw Xtreme, who called themselves The Machynes of Wrestling on 20 June 2011 and won the PWA Tag Team Championships in a ladder match against Victor and CM Monster on 2 July.
